entities.name: Henrik Böhm
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henrik Böhm was a Hungarian Jewish architect who worked primarily in the Secessionist style. In partnership with Ármin Hegedűs, he designed numerous public buildings, banks, spas, and hotels throughout Austria-Hungary and its successor states, including the Török Bank in Budapest, the Újpest Town Hall, and the Thermia Palace in Piešťany.
